recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If future namespace-extension work is needed, maintain the Tools IG replacement definition and Extension Pack retired-extension pointer rather than reintroducing elementdefinition-namespace content to core.
issue_request: FHIR-28413 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to document a value for the elementdefinition-namespace extension that represents XML with no assigned namespace; the approved modification was to use `noNamespace` rather than `default`.
initial_application: Core commit e330dcd5111b81c2120748957b7666a9ea56ed33 applied the issue by adding the `noNamespace` sentence to source/datatypes/elementdefinition-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed that extension row as part of removing extension definitions from the R5 core source.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini does not list source/datatypes/elementdefinition-extensions-spreadsheet.xml as an active profile input, and current core source has no elementdefinition-namespace or xml-namespace definition to edit. The FHIR Extension Pack retains elementdefinition-namespace only as a retired extension pointing to http://hl7.org/fhir/tools/StructureDefinition/xml-namespace. The published/current Tools IG xml-namespace StructureDefinition includes the requested `noNamespace` documentation.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The current core checkout no longer owns the affected extension definition, and the replacement external artifact already reflects the approved behavior.
